info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Audit Reporting API
info.description: The Internal Audit Reporting API allows authorized users to access and retrieve detailed auditing information related to enterprise banking services. This API serves as a critical tool for compliance officers and internal auditors who need to evaluate transaction integrity and operational efficiencies. Users can query specific audit records by providing the appropriate parameters, enhancing transparency within the audit processes. Ideal for regulatory assessments and internal reviews, this API streamlines oversight and accountability in banking operations.

get.summary: Retrieve Internal Audit details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific internal audit identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045).

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve internal audit records for the specified resource. It specifies the criteria for filtering the audit information relevant to the 'RES-100045' resource.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.

GetInternalAuditByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the internal audit operation, specifically for the GET request operation. It is expected to be a string representation of the data.

GetInternalAuditByIdResponse_200.title: Audit Operation Response

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication mechanism that requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header. Ensure that the provided token is valid and has not expired for successful authentication.
